display-amount.purpose: Live amount in the add sheet.

display-balance.purpose: Net worth on the balance card; savings hero and pot detail totals.

picker-date.purpose: Selected date in the calendar header (22px on desktop).

picker-wheel.purpose: Hour and minute wheel items; 720 for the selected item.

subtotal.purpose: Card-level figures and pot name; 24px for the home savings total.

input.purpose: Mobile text inputs, 16px to prevent focus zoom.

body-sm.purpose: Links, card labels, settings values, field labels, notification body.

body-strong.purpose: Row titles and button labels (540 to 600).

label.purpose: Secondary lines, day headers, segmented and chip labels.

caption.purpose: Meta under amounts, flow labels on the card.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting panels, groups, icon buttons, search, segmented thumb.

shadows.name: glass-tabbar
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--surface) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.6) blur(18px)

shadows.name: glass-notification
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--surface) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8)

shadows.name: ring-category
shadows.purpose: Selected category tile in the add sheet.

shadows.name: ring-inset
shadows.purpose: Selected icon option (1.5px violet for selected chips).

shadows.name: scrim-picker
shadows.purpose: Behind mobile pickers; none on desktop popovers.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Presses, segmented thumbs (260-280ms), switch knob (240ms), savings bar (400ms), new row (420ms), toast enter (320ms).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Add sheet open (460ms) and notification enter (520ms).

motion.name: picker-popover
motion.value: scale(.96) to none, 200ms ease-out in, 140ms ease-out out

motion.name: calendar-slide
motion.purpose: Month change, in the direction of travel; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressed feedback on buttons, FAB, keys, chips.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Page cross-fade when the theme changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition/animation-duration 1ms; scrim and toast keep 160ms opacity

themes.mechanism: data-theme attribute on :root overrides prefers-color-scheme; choice persisted in localStorage
controls: Header icon button (moon in light, sun in dark) on the mobile home header
Rail item "Dark mode" / "Light mode" on desktop
Settings > Appearance segmented control: System / Light / Dark

numberFormat.pattern: integer, comma thousands grouping, suffix at 0.62em and 72% opacity

narrative.overview:
Moni yem is the category standard for a personal finance app, executed without irony: one solid violet card holding the money, everything else calm, tinted, and quiet around it. The quality bar is Revolut, Wave, Monarch / Copilot Money and Apple Wallet. The home screen answers one question first ("where am I this month?") and refuses the gadget dashboard full of widgets. Density is iOS-native: generous 14 to 18px panel padding, 42px category tiles, 48px buttons, a thumb-height tab bar with the add action in the middle.

The world is built from violet-tinted neutrals (every grey carries hue 315 to 320), a single saturated brand color, and a fixed 12-color category palette that the user picks from. Depth is soft and ambient, tinted with the brand's own dark plum. Motion borrows iOS physics: a drawer curve for sheets, pickers and notifications, a quick ease-out for presses. Native browser pickers are replaced by in-world ones (calendar, time wheels). Light and dark are both first-class and the user can switch at any time from the header.

All money is tabular, integer FCFA with comma grouping and the currency as a smaller, dimmed suffix (`3,012,250 FCFA`). The interface copy is English, second person, short and warm ("Good evening,", "2 days without an entry", "Time for a quick check-in?").
keyCharacteristics: One solid violet balance card (#9518ad) per screen at most; violet elsewhere is sparse (active tab, FAB, primary button, switches, selected day, focus).
Every category color comes from one 12-token palette, each with a dark-mode value, and is tinted at 14%.
Manrope, tabular figures everywhere, tight negative tracking on large numbers.
Generous, nested rounded corners (28 / 26 / 22 / 16 / 14 / 12 / 10px), tile radius scaled to tile size.
Lucide line icons at 1.75 stroke, 20px default.
Custom calendar and time-wheel pickers: bottom sheet on mobile, anchored popover on desktop.
Light, dark and system themes, with a visible header toggle.

rules.name: The One Violet Card Rule
rules.body: Solid brand fill on a large surface is reserved for the balance card. Every other surface is white/night plum on the tinted page; violet appears in small doses.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral, border and shadow carries the violet hue (around oklch hue 315 to 320). Do not introduce neutral greys or black shadows in light mode.

rules.name: The Palette Key Rule
rules.body: A category's color is always one of the 12 pal-* tokens, chosen by key, with its own dark value and a 14% tint. No category gets a raw hex.

rules.name: The Quiet Spending Rule
rules.body: Spending is shown in ink with a "−" sign, not red. Only income is colored (green). Red means something is wrong or destructive.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular figures, slight negative tracking (-0.01em), no wrapping, comma thousands grouping and a dimmed "FCFA" suffix: `125,000 FCFA`. Calendar days and time wheels are tabular too.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Manrope only. Contrast through weight steps and size, not through a display face.

rules.name: The No-Zoom Input Rule
rules.body: Text inputs are at least 16px on mobile.

rules.name: The Plum Shadow Rule
rules.body: Light-mode shadows are tinted rgba(45,10,55) or rgba(30,8,36), never neutral black, and never hard-edged.

dos: Do keep solid violet (#9518ad) on large surfaces to the balance card; use violet ink for violet text.
Do tint neutrals and light-mode shadows with the plum hue.
Do set every amount with tabular figures, comma grouping and a dimmed "FCFA" suffix (`3,012,250 FCFA`).
Do give every category a pal-* key and render it as the hue on a 14% tint, in both themes.
Do ship every new surface in light and dark, and keep the header theme toggle reachable.
Do nest radii from 28px down to 9px as elements nest, scale tile radius with tile size, and keep pills for chips, switches and badges.
Do use the in-world calendar and time-wheel pickers instead of native date and time inputs; sheet on mobile, anchored 336px popover on desktop.
Do keep text inputs at 16px or more on mobile.
Do isolate destructive actions in a danger zone and explain why they are disabled.
Do use Lucide line icons at 1.75 stroke (2.1 to 2.2 for active and FAB states).
Do open sheets, pickers and banners on the drawer curve and close them faster.
donts: Don't color spending red; use ink with "−" and keep red for errors and destructive actions.
Don't give a category a raw hex outside the 12-color palette.
Don't add a second typeface or a display font; contrast comes from Manrope weights.
Don't use hard, unblurred offset shadows or neutral black shadows in light mode.
Don't fill the home screen with widgets; it answers "where am I this month?" first.
Don't add uppercase labels above headings; uppercase lives only inside the OS-style notification header.
